label: R19-FP-BALANCED-SCAN
title: Replace the FP 256-bit linear leading-one scan with a balanced encoder
timing_input: T-014 pp_pre->pack_pre was -2.103 ns/59 levels; R18 moved the same 256-bit priority scan to pp_pre->pack_scan and fresh T-020 STA is pending.
scope: Replace only round_pack_scan's linear 256-bit leading-one search with a balanced synthesizable priority encoder while preserving zero/special handling, lead_valid, lead index and exp2+h for all H/S/D and paired-half lanes. Do not add an FSM state or change latency.
validation: Owner: static checks and focused scan equivalence vectors without heavy runtime. Integrator: R18 scalar, FP wrapper, P7 H/S/D/NEON, L2 strict and fresh directional STA.
acceptance: Balanced scan is bit-exact across zero and every possible lead position, focused tests preserve raw results/flags and no architectural or nominal-latency behavior changes. No timing claim before physical STA.
result: Independent review found no RTL blocker. Exhaustive focused scan metadata and the affected scalar/NEON L0-L2 union passed on the R19 candidate; physical timing remains pending.
